Not built from the house template; mapped onto the intake schema to run the PM delivery review. Values are read from the document; absences are the document's.

document.title: Afni Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform
document.subtitle: Google Cloud Proof of Concept, Comparative TCO & Target Architecture

customer.profile: Afni is a global BPO provider whose analytics estate supports internal operations and a portfolio of enterprise clients, each with distinct data isolation, contractual and reporting obligations. Afni is selecting a strategic data and analytics platform to replace Azure Synapse and in-scope Informatica, through an RFI with a common POC and TCO evidence standard.

background.objective: Build both Sales Chat proof-of-concept scenarios on Google Cloud using Afni source data, produce a target architecture for the in-scope Synapse estate, and deliver a bottom-up 1-, 3- and 5-year TCO model, as Google Cloud's evidence in Afni's platform RFI.

schedule.activity: Kickoff, lineage walkthroughs, rubric review, data-handling approval
Target architecture & TDD; governance baseline; POC 1 ingestion
Reduced capacity over holiday period. POC 1 transformation & assertions; POC 2 ingestion
POC 1 semantic layer, Tableau coexistence, lineage; POC 2 evaluation pipeline
schedule.deliverable: POC 1 scorecard data product; Tableau validation artifact

schedule.activity: POC 1 reconciliation; POC 2 human review & agreement report; governance and observability packs
schedule.deliverable: Reconciliation report; POC 2 pipeline; versioned configuration record; governance pack; observability evidence

schedule.activity: TCO model; migration roadmap; evidence pack; executive showcase
schedule.deliverable: TCO model; migration roadmap; evaluation evidence pack; executive showcase

resources.role: Data & AI Solutions Engineer (lead), AI Engineer, Solution Architect / CTO (part-time), Engagement Manager

prerequisites_before: Final source inventory and lineage documentation from the BI and Data Engineering teams.
Representative raw files and data samples, including at least one cleansing or structural-change case.
The current Tableau scorecard workbook and data source, and the Afni-approved KPI and calculation definitions.
A validation sample with expected outputs for reconciliation.
Security roles, test accounts, and vendor connectivity requirements.
Sufficient history to validate trend, period-over-period, and ranking behaviour.
Current transcript lineage and process documentation from Jefren/ABS.
A representative transcript sample with associated metadata and approved access controls.
The exact Sales Chat quality rubric, definitions, weighting and scoring rules, and expected output schema.
A human-reviewed benchmark set for objective comparison.
Required organizational and hierarchy reference data.
Security and privacy handling requirements, and the approved vendor test-access method.
Usage facts for the TCO model, including in-scope Informatica job counts with complexity tiers.
Executed NDA and documented client-data restrictions governing vendor access to Afni and Afni client data.
A single Afni point of contact.
Stakeholders aligned to attend kickoff, the executive showcase, and a weekly 30-minute status call.
assumptions: Afni provides timely review and feedback, within three business days of each deliverable submission.
Services are delivered remotely unless on-site attendance is mutually agreed.
Reduced delivery capacity is assumed for the period December 22 - January 2.
Afni's evaluation timeline (Day 30 / Day 60 / Day 90) remains as described in the RFI. Material change to that timeline is handled by Change Request.
Google Cloud product behaviour, pricing, and regional availability are as published at the effective date.
The prerequisite gate is met by December 10, 2026. Delay to the gate shifts dependent deliverable dates by an equivalent period.
success_criteria: Both Sales Chat proof-of-concept scenarios are built and demonstrated on Afni data, and every Must-priority requirement in Afni's POC 1 and POC 2 requirement documents is either satisfied with evidence or explicitly reported as not satisfied with the reason stated.
POC 1 output reconciles to the Afni-approved validation sample, or every difference is reconciled and explained (SC-A1).

An Afni evaluator can trace a displayed metric from Tableau through semantic definition and transformation to source data (SC-A2), and trace an evaluation result to its source conversation evidence and the configuration that produced it (TR-A3).
The criterion-level agreement report against Afni's human-reviewed benchmark is delivered, including disagreements and failure cases (TR-A2).
The 1-, 3-, and 5-year TCO model is delivered with all assumptions, units, rates, and sensitivity drivers exposed and auditable by Afni's Finance reviewers.
Afni confirms in writing that the deliverables and activities outlined in Section 3 have been completed as agreed.

assumed: sow_type infrastructure_build, as the nearest archetype for a platform evaluation with two POCs, a target architecture and a TCO model.
msa_style dated_mpsa, because the Change Request form asks for the 'Date of Master Services Agreement'.
unanswered: The governing agreement is named 'Premier Cloud Services Agreement' in the preamble and 'Master Services Agreement' in the Change Request form, with no date and no link; the Afni MSA has been in Afni legal review since September.
No payment trigger or 'subject to Google approval' language for the DAF line.
The 300 hours are not split by role or phase.
Signatory names and titles are blank on both sides.
